items.info: Canopy. Check the windscreen and canopy.
items.label: Windscreen & Canopy

items.info: Canopy. Remove and stow the MDC firing handle safety pin.
items.label: MDC Canopy PIN

items.info: Seat. Remove and stow the ejection seat safety pin.
items.label: Ejection Seat PIN

items.label: LDG GEAR Handle

items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Seat. Fasten the harness and leg restraints.
items.label: Harness

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. ICC 1 and 2 are the engine generators. ICC 3, marked IPP, is the IPP generator.
items.label: ICC 1, 2 & 3

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. Positions DUMP, NORM and ALTN. The knob has no function in the sim.
items.label: Cabin Pressure

items.info: Left Panel. Main battery switch.
items.label: BATT Switch

items.info: Left Panel. Middle position.
items.label: IPP Selector

items.info: Left Panel. IPP emergency off switch, guard closed.
items.label: IPP EMER OFF

items.info: Left Panel.
items.label: ENGINE Switch

items.info: Left Panel.
items.label: Rudder Trim

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Stores jettison selector.
items.label: JETTISON Selector

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Alternate gear extension, guard closed.
items.label: ALT GEAR EXT

items.info: Center Instrument Panel. Down position.
items.label: Master Arm

items.info: Center Instrument Panel. Helmet-mounted display selector.
items.label: HMD Selector

items.info: Center Instrument Panel. Multifunction display selector.
items.label: MFD Selector

items.info: Right Vertical Panel. Auto recovery switch, guard closed.
items.label: AUTO RECOVERY

items.info: Right Vertical Panel. Aircraft zeroize selector.
items.label: ZEROIZE Selector

items.info: Right Panel. Control stick arm rest.
items.label: Stick Arm Rest

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. All three must be ON to power the engine start.
items.label: ICC 1, 2 & 3

items.info: Left Panel. Main battery switch.
items.label: BATT Switch

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. Starts the IPP. The green light next to the knob starts blinking.
items.label: IPP Selector

items.info: Left Panel, next to the IPP knob. Blinks while the IPP starts and stays steady once it is running. The BURN caption also shows between the engine and fuel FABs.
items.label: IPP Light

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. Middle position. Turn back once the green light is steady.
items.label: IPP Selector

items.info: Main Panel. The Panoramic Cockpit Display should come on.
items.label: PCD

items.info: PCD ENG page.
items.label: PCD ENG Page

items.info: PCD FUEL page. Check the fuel quantity.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: PCD FUEL page. Main fuel shutoff valve (MSFOV). Open as required.
items.label: Fuel Shutoff Valve

items.info: PCD MENU, LITES page, POSIT. Turns on the wing navigation lights.
items.label: Position Lights

items.info: Left Panel. Guarded switch.
items.label: ENGINE Switch

items.info: Left Panel. Move from OFF to IDLE.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: PCD ENG page. Monitor the engine start.
items.label: Engine Start

items.info: PCD left side. The GENERATOR LOW message should go out once the engine is running.
items.label: GEN LOW Message

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel. The knob stays in AUTO after the start.
items.label: IPP Selector

items.info: Center Instrument Panel. Helmet-mounted display.
items.label: HMD

items.info: PCD. Adjust display brightness as desired.
items.label: PCD Brightness

items.info: PCD. Set up COMS, VOR/ILS and TACAN as desired.
items.label: COMS & NAV

items.info: Left Vertical Panel.
items.label: LAND/TAXI Lights

items.info: PCD. Set the Mode 3A squawk code, then select GROUND.
items.label: IFF / Squawk

items.info: PCD. Set local altimeter pressure.
items.label: Altimeter

items.info: Backup flight instrument. Check it is on and aligned.
items.label: Backup Instruments

items.info: PCD FUEL page. Set the BINGO and JOKER fuel values.
items.label: BINGO & JOKER

items.info: PCD NAV page. Check the flight plan waypoints are loaded and set the NAV source. Flight plans are entered on the world map.
items.label: NAV Waypoints

items.info: Left Panel. Advance the throttle slowly to 70% and check normal readings on the PCD ENG page. Back to IDLE and check EGT and RPM.
items.label: Engine Run-Up

items.info: Stick and pedals. Check free and full movement.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: PCD FUEL page. Click REFUEL SYSTEM and check the refuel door or probe opens (external view). Click REFUEL PRE CNTCT and check it closes.
items.label: Refuel System

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. With the FCS page up, press the HOOK/STOVL button. Check the HOOK message and the hook extended (external view). Press again and check the hook retracts and the message clears.
items.label: Arrestor Hook

items.info: Radio.
items.label: ATC Clearance

items.info: Stick pinkie switch, bound to the sim's SET NOSE WHEEL STEERING TO LIMIT control. Steering starts disengaged, so the nose wheel will not turn until it is engaged.
items.label: Nose Wheel Steering

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Release to begin taxi.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedals. Apply power slowly and test the brakes and steering during taxi.
items.label: Brakes & Steering

items.info: PCD. Check the flight instruments during taxi.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: Canopy. Closed and locked.
items.label: Canopy

items.info: Seat. A SEAT NOT ARMED caution shows above 80% RPM if the seat is still safe.
items.label: Ejection Seat

items.info: Speed brake control. Fully retracted.
items.label: Speed Brakes

items.info: Pitot and engine anti-ice.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Sim flaps key (or the FCS button). Any flaps position but UP selects MAN mode: manual trim, with the G and AoA limiters off. The FCS page shows MAN. Recommended for every takeoff.
items.label: FCS Mode

items.info: Elevator trim. Set 7 to 10 depending on payload.
items.label: Elevator Trim

items.info: Center Instrument Panel.
items.label: Master Arm

items.info: Helmet.
items.label: Helmet Visor

items.info: PCD MENU, LITES page, STROB.
items.label: Strobe Lights

items.info: PCD. Switch from GROUND to ON for takeoff.
items.label: IFF

items.info: Left Panel. Hold the brakes and set 80% N2 before brake release.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: Pedals.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Left Panel. Military Rated Thrust, about 105%.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: Stick. Lift the nose at 150 to 170 KIAS. Airborne at 170 to 200 KIAS.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Retract at a positive rate of climb.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Gear handle up, no green lights.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Sim flaps key UP (or the FCS button). AUTO mode trims by itself and turns the G and AoA limiters on. The FCS page shows AUTO. Select once stabilized above 100 ft AGL.
items.label: FCS Mode

items.info: PCD. Check normal indications.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: PCD FCS page, A/P. Set the modes on the AP/AT page: ALT SEL, HDG SEL or RTE HOLD to follow the flight plan.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Left Panel. Check cabin pressurization.
items.label: Cabin Pressure

items.info: PCD FUEL page.
items.label: Fuel State

items.info: Left Vertical Panel and PCD Menu Lights page.
items.label: Lights

items.info: Left Panel.
items.label: Canopy Defog

items.info: PCD. Set standard pressure (29.92/1013) at the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeter

items.info: Center Instrument Panel.
items.label: Master Arm

items.info: PCD. Set the displays, COMS and NAV as needed.
items.label: COMS & NAV

items.info: PCD. Set local pressure passing the transition level on descent.
items.label: Altimeter

items.info: Left Vertical Panel.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: PCD FCS page, A/P. The pattern and landing are flown by hand.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Upwind leg. Runway heading at 400 to 500 KIAS.
items.label: Pattern Entry

items.info: Upwind leg, at least 1.5 NM abeam. Enter at 400 to 500 KIAS and break into the downwind leg at 3G. Roll out at about 250 to 300 KIAS and hold 800 ft AGL.
items.label: Break Turn

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Downwind leg, below 300 KIAS.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Sim flaps key (or the FCS button). Any flaps position but UP selects MAN mode: manual trim, with the G and AoA limiters off. Above 400 KIAS in MAN the FCS DEGRADED caution shows. Depending on the PMD/DR page setting, gear down or descending below 50 ft AGL selects MAN by itself.
items.label: FCS Mode

items.info: Downwind leg. Use if needed to slow onto On Speed AOA.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Downwind leg. Stabilize On Speed AOA, then descend to 600 ft AGL.
items.label: On Speed AOA

items.info: Downwind leg, at least 1.5 NM abeam. Turn at about 30° bank, On Speed AOA, holding 600 ft AGL.
items.label: Base Turn

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Check gear down, 3 green.
items.label: Gear Indication

items.info: Final. Roll out at about 1.5 NM and 600 ft AGL, then descend to the runway.
items.label: Pattern Altitude

items.info: Final. Hold On Speed AOA and aim the flight path vector at the runway threshold.
items.label: AOA

items.info: Stick. Slight flare to about 11° AOA at the threshold. FPV at the upper end of the E bracket.
items.label: Threshold Flare

items.info: Left Panel. Retard slowly. No idle until touchdown. Aim for a 300 to 500 fpm sink rate at touchdown.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: Left Panel. After touchdown.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: Stick. Keep the nose up as long as possible.
items.label: Nose Attitude

items.info: After touchdown. Check the speed brakes have deployed.
items.label: Speed Brakes

items.info: Left Vertical Panel. Prevents the aircraft from rolling.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Seat.
items.label: Ejection Seat

items.info: Left Vertical Panel.
items.label: LAND/TAXI Lights

items.info: Left Panel. Full aft. Stops the engine. The IPP shuts down by itself once the engine stops.
items.label: Throttle

items.info: Left Panel, PTMS panel.
items.label: BATT Switch

description: Conventional takeoff and landing (CTOL) variant of the F-35, with most systems run through the panoramic cockpit display.
